notes.title: Demo out now!
notes.content:
I’ve just released the public demo for Guard Break, which you can download on the game’s store page:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3324590/Guard_Break/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3324590/Guard_Break/[/url]

The demo offers approximately 60 to 90 minutes of gameplay from the game’s opening, introducing players to the setting, core mechanics, and early character arcs. Demo progress will carry over to the full release..

Would love to hear thoughts and feedback, whether it be via the [url=https://discord.gg/vhe4JVpaP9]Discord channel[/url] or elsewhere!

[previewyoutube=Wvspc6KojS0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: UPDATE: Steam Playtest Now Closed
notes.content:
UPDATE - 2nd May: Closed now, thanks for trying it and sending feedback!

--------

Hey everyone,

An open Steam Playtest for [i]Guard Break[/i] is now live. This includes the same content planned for the upcoming demo- roughly the first hour of the game.

I'm using this playtest period to get initial impressions on things like pacing, combat mechanics, and overall feel. If you'd like to try it early and share your thoughts, I'd really appreciate it.

[list]
[*] Click "Request Access" on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3324590/Guard_Break/]store page[/url] to join automatically
[*] Playtest length is TBD- likely a couple of weeks at least
[*] Feedback welcome via [url=https://discord.gg/vhe4JVpaP9]Discord[/url] or the in-game form link
[/list] 
Thanks for the support!
